(shape ``[out_features, in_features]``, the standard ``nn.Linear`` layout)
and each rank stores only its own partition as a leaf parameter.

* ``ColumnParallelLinear`` splits the weight matrix along its columns,
  i.e. the output dimension.  Each rank computes a partial output which is
  reassembled with an ``all_gather`` along the last dimension (as if the
  partial outputs were concatenated).  The bias is sharded in the same
  way as the output dimension: rank ``r`` holds the slice of the bias that
  corresponds to its ``out_features / world_size`` outputs.

* ``RowParallelLinear`` splits the weight matrix along its rows, i.e. the
  input dimension.  The input is split accordingly, each rank computes a
  partial output and the partial outputs are summed with an ``all_reduce``.
  The bias remains full (of shape ``[out_features]``) on every rank and is
  added after the reduce.
